title: Day-Count Register of Whole Life Insurance Policy Forms: Interest Extinguished at a Loan Offset
content:
The part of a year for which interest is extinguished at a loan offset on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy follows the loan-interest accrual convention printed in the policy form, which the issue date sets.

- **Policy issued before January 1, 1985:** whole policy months from the start of the interest to the date the offset takes effect, over **12**; a remaining part month is not charged.
- **Policy issued from January 1, 1985 through December 31, 2004:** the actual calendar days, over **360**.
- **Policy issued on or after January 1, 2005:** the actual calendar days, over **365**.

A whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the start date is reached.

## Register examples (hypothetical, interest from March 1, 2025 to August 12, 2025, 164 days)

| Issue date | Convention | Part of a year |
|---|---|---|
| April 4, 1979 | Whole months: 5 (March 1 to August 1; the days to August 12 are a part month) | 5 over 12 |
| April 4, 1993 | Actual days over 360 | 164 over 360 |
| April 4, 2008 | Actual days over 365 | 164 over 365 |

Boundaries: issued December 31, 1984, whole months; January 1, 1985, 360-day year; December 31, 2004, 360-day year; January 1, 2005, 365-day year.
